notes: «- وهو ابن سلام -» and «- يعني أخاه -» are editor glosses, left out
the saying is heard by two men («أنهما، سمعا») and the text names only one of them after الحكم: the second hearer is written as unnamed
«أنحدثاه» is read as «أن حدثاه» (both narrated to him); the text is not otherwise garbled
